about_the_game:
The Calling

Since ancient times, ravens have been seen as messengers between realms — keepers of secrets and watchers of fate. In fCorvus, you step into their world, where every shadow hides a clue and every enigma leads you closer to the truth about this Fabulous Creature.

1. Jigsaw — Set the Scene

Begin by assembling scattered fragments of the world. Each piece you fit reveals a part of the story, forming the stage where your investigation begins.

2. Click — The Flight Begins
Once the image is complete, the scene comes alive. Ravens and crows glide across the screen, quick, unpredictable, and watching you back. Catch them all before they vanish into the mist.

3. Search — Become the Seeker
Now, the real mystery unfolds. Follow the clues, read between the symbols, and unravel the riddles that point to the right raven.

4. Find — Truth in the Shadows
Among the many, only one hides the answer. Discover it to complete your investigation, and prepare for what lies ahead.

5. Compete — Rise in the Flock
Speed is your ally. The faster you solve, the higher you climb on the leaderboard. Challenge a friend in versus or co-op mode and prove who reads the signs better.

6. Unlock — Achievements
Earn unique achievements as you uncover secrets and complete each chapter. Every challenge conquered is another mark in your legend.

7. Discover — Glossary
Progressively unlock the Raven’s Codex, a growing glossary filled with myths, symbols, and lore surrounding the corvid world.

8. Collect — Album
Every enigma solved adds a new illustration to your album. A visual diary of your journey through the unknown.

9. The Mystery Awaits
fCorvus is not just a game, it’s a descent into the language of omens, art, and hidden meaning. Look closely. The truth is always watching.

10. Call to Action — Join the Hunt
The ravens are already waiting. Add fCorvus to your wishlist to be among the first to uncover what lies beyond the veil.

Key Features:

  • Artistic and immersive scenes inspired by mythology and symbolism

  • Relaxing Hidden Object gameplay focused on discovery and learning

  • Illustrated and animated curiosities about ravens from around the world

  • Engaging soundtrack and contemplative atmosphere

  •  Part of an anthology exploring mythical creatures and their meanings

Minimum:

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 9.0

short_description: Solve puzzles, uncover riddles, and hunt crows and ravens through layered scenes of mystery. Assemble, search, and compete to reveal the hidden truth in a world where every shadow tells a story. Play solo, with or versus a friend. Learn about the fabulous corvus.
